title: Jammy Springy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A crowd-pleasing Algerian dish featuring lamb, pistachio, and bonito flakes, cooked to perfection in a slate-tile vessel, this paleo-friendly tagine is a jammy and springy delight. It is a hearty and flavorful meal that is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, pistachio, bonito flakes, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and sear the lamb mixture until browned on all sides.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the skillet contents to a slate-tile vessel and cover with a lid.
Transfer the vessel to the preheated oven and cook for 2.5 hours.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
